comment: The experimental-runtime lane's expected failures (#2256 U3, #2338), read by tools/expruntime-ratchet. First measured 2026-11-11 on epic/upstream-runtime by running `make test-experimental-ratchet`, not estimated. Every failure is a gap-table row: almost all are refusals by design (the toggle refuses a construct the new runtime cannot handle yet instead of planning it wrongly, so a test that uses it fails on the refusal); the rest name an accepted or loud-failing row, or the toggle's own warning. None is a marker, identity or record test. failures: tests that fail with TOFU_X_EXPERIMENTAL_RUNTIME=1. skips: fork-owned tests that call SkipExperimental. The list only shrinks: when a gap row closes, its tests pass and the ratchet requires taking them off.

Runs since the replacecycle fork port (#2380) turned ExperimentalBugStateCBD on, and fails on its last check: the new runtime records create_before_destroy in state, but on a plain create only the configured value, not one inherited from a create_before_destroy dependent. The inherited (effective) order is decided at plan time and is not carried into the execution graph; the next plan records it on the existing object. Waits for upstream (upstream #4714).

Upstream's new runtime, by design: a provider configured from values unknown until apply is not refused, since providers now accept unknown values (upstream's ExperimentalChangeDeferredActions note on this test). It runs because the deferral fork port (#2382) turns that flag on for the tests it makes pass, TestContext2Plan_countComputedModule and TestContext2Plan_forEachUnknownValue.

Runs since the datasources fork port (#2414) and fails on behaviour, gaps "data-sources" and "checks-conditions": a data source's failing postcondition is reported as a warning, not an error, in a normal plan, and it does not stop the evaluation of what depends on the data source, so an index into its empty result adds an error the default runtime never reaches. Follow-up to #2414.

Runs since the datasources fork port (#2414) and fails on behaviour, gaps "data-sources" and "checks-conditions": a check block's scoped data source is read and its errors are warnings, but its read failure is not recorded as the check's failure in the plan's and state's check results (C3, #2410), statuses after the apply's re-read stay unknown, and a reference into a check block's scoped data source from outside is not refused with the default runtime's "Reference to scoped resource" error. 3 of its 10 subtests pass. Follow-up to #2414.

It drives internal/tofu's graph; on the new runtime the same rule is covered by internal/resources' TestManagedResourceTypePlanChanges_requiresReplaceMalformedPathDropped and _requiresReplaceBogusNamedPathStillErrors, which this lane runs.
